title: Countable gluing of an image-integral identity over a disjoint measurable partition (parent steps 2 and 5)
statement: Let X be a type with a σ-algebra and μ a measure on X. Let f: X → X be injective, mapping μ-null sets to μ-null sets and μ-null-measurable sets to μ-null-measurable sets. Let Z ⊆ X be μ-null-measurable, (D_i)_{i∈ℕ} pairwise disjoint measurable sets with μ(Z ∖ ⋃_i D_i) = 0, and u, g: X → [0, ∞] arbitrary functions such that ∫⁻_{f(Z ∩ D_i)} u dμ = ∫⁻_{Z ∩ D_i} g dμ for every i. Then ∫⁻_{f(Z)} u dμ = ∫⁻_Z g dμ.
lean_statement: ∀ (X : Type) [MeasurableSpace X] (μ : Measure X) (f : X → X) (Z : Set X) (D : ℕ → Set X) (u g : X → ℝ≥0∞), Function.Injective f → (∀ Y : Set X, μ Y = 0 → μ (f '' Y) = 0) → (∀ Y : Set X, NullMeasurableSet Y μ → NullMeasurableSet (f '' Y) μ) → NullMeasurableSet Z μ → (∀ i, MeasurableSet (D i)) → Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Disjoint (D i) (D j)) → μ (Z \ ⋃ i, D i) = 0 → (∀ i, ∫⁻ y in f '' (Z ∩ D i), u y ∂μ = ∫⁻ x in Z ∩ D i, g x ∂μ) → ∫⁻ y in f '' Z, u y ∂μ = ∫⁻ x in Z, g x ∂μ
